# rendered

**Generated by CI on main. Do not edit** (PRs touching `apps/`, `argocd/`, `kargo/`, `pipelines/`, `codeowners/`, `infrastructure/` fail).
Read by the ApplicationSets in `platform/appsets/` (ADR 0017): `kargo/` (hub), `argocd/projects/<region>/` + `argocd/deploys/<region>/` (each region), `infrastructure/regions/` (hub-side per-region add-ons).

Workloads never sync from here directly: Kargo promotion copies
`apps/<cap>/<app>/<stage>/<target>/` onto branch `env/<cap>/<app>/<target>`, which Argo CD tracks.
Rollback: promote older Freight in Kargo, or revert the source change in `capabilities/`.
